name: omgbase-workspace
description: Open Markdown Graph Base — workspace root

scripts.interop: cargo build -p omgbase && pnpm build && pnpm --filter @omgbase/core exec vitest run corpus/surface/interop.test.ts && cargo test -p omgbase --test interop
scripts.rlink: pnpm -r build && for pkg in packages/*/; do grep -q '"bin"' "$pkg/package.json" && (cd "$pkg" && pnpm add -g .); done
